name: Remy Goldstein
headline: Partner @ VU Venture Partners & Venture University (VU) | CDTM | Professional development for the next generation of investors | Build your track record inside our global VC fund
summary:
I’m an entrepreneur-turned-investor and Partner at VU Venture Partners and Venture University (VU), where we help the next generation of capital allocators gain real investing experience — not just theory.

VU is a professional development program where participants step inside our live venture fund, source real deals, lead due diligence, sit on investment committees, and build a portfolio-backed track record. It’s hands-on, global, and designed for people serious about investing well — whether as GPs, LPs, angels, operators, or founders transitioning to the other side.

Before VU, I built and led companies, managed capital, and worked across startup and institutional investing. Today, I focus on helping others move from curiosity to clarity — through structured investing experience, global peer networks, and the conviction it takes to back what matters.

I believe Venture Capital, VC, is a craft — and it should be learned like one: by doing it, not just watching from the sidelines.

If you’re exploring how to break into VC, launch a fund, invest more strategically, or accelerate your path as an allocator — let’s talk.

—

💬 Let’s connect if you’re:
• Looking to invest with structure, not just instinct
• Building or scaling a fund or syndicate
• A founder or expert exploring the investor side
• Seeking a modern, professional path into venture capital

Solomon was on the mission to empower modern insurance companies to offer modern services to policyholders through user-centric software and data intelligence.

Solomon has validated a concept that is purchasable. If you are interested in our teaser deck, please reach out:

- In the early “.com”-days insurances were not able to offer modern customer acquisition experiences.
Consequently, insurances are now dependent on comparison portals, e.g., Check24, which results in large chunks of (traditional) customer acquisition channels being lost.

positions.title: Pina x CDTM | Strategy Development Consultant
positions.description:
With only decades left in the battle against climate change, a handful of startups are currently dedicating their energy to positively impacting our environment. At the forefront of this fight against climate change in Germany is Pina with its mission to protect our forests by quantifying and rewarding sustainable forestry. 

With traction growing in Germany, Pina realized the need for follow-on markets to ensure long-term growth. However, researching new markets while developing their current market isn’t viable for an early-stage startup. As an interdisciplinary team of three, we took on the challenge of identifying the most promising follow-on markets for Pina.

The project was composed of three milestones. The first identified possible follow-on market opportunities across Europe, resulting in the ten most viable follow-on markets. Second, the three most promising follow-on markets were methodically selected and thoroughly researched. Finally, we drafted a go-to-market strategy detailing how to enter the identified #1 market.

This project was in cooperation with CDTM's Entrepreneurship Laboratory.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for the first Quantum Entrepreneurship Laboratory

The Quantum Entrepreneurship Laboratory is a project-based course that brings together students of different backgrounds with reputable industry partners and selected quantum specialists to explore new commercial applications of quantum computing. 

Within this course, I was part of the Teaching Assistants team supporting the organizers and students throughout the course. While giving input on team dynamics, pitching, stakeholder conflict management, team organization, storytelling, business modeling, ppt design, communication strategy, and more I was able to find interest in quantum computing and its application to industry problems – a system critical technology that will play a commoditized role in the not too distant future.

positions.title: Celonis x CDTM | Product Development Consultant
positions.description:
As a team of five, we set off on our 13-week managing product development journey. The team was made up of a data scientist, a mechanical engineer, a computer scientist, a physicist, and a business student. We developed an application that leverages Celonis’ new technology to optimize business processes in accounts receivable departments.

A Celonis technology, (previously) called operational apps, allows multiple stakeholders of a company to interact with one another through individualized views. These apps put AI to work in processes, automating tasks, prescribing guidance to employees, and prioritizing workflows according to desired targets.
Our project’s objective was to reduce friction in corporate finance by developing an operational app. Through user interviews and desk research, we identified our focus area: accounts receivable departments, which are responsible for collecting the money of a company. One of the biggest challenges they face is inefficient communication, forcing employees to write emails 75% of their time and costing a large company $165m every year on average. We designed user workflows to make the money collection faster and found ways to overcome the challenge of inefficient communication within the department and across the company.

We created value for Celonis in three main areas. Firstly, we built an operational app with visionary team management features onto their app store. Secondly, we developed a pricing strategy and an overall concept for what strategic partnerships between third party app developers and Celonis could look like in the future. Lastly, we challenged the status quo of the new technology by testing its integrity from an external perspective.

This project was in corporation with CDTM's Managing Product Development course.

To improve the health, happiness, and productivity of employees, the Boost Initiative is a framework to reinforce a positive working culture, structure internal initiatives, and engage remote team members with the organization. The initiative is a bottom-up, highly personal, and authentic way to boost company dynamics. I was inspired to launch this program, based on a similar program in the German Deloitte Digital oﬃce. company.name: Venture University
company.tagline: The World's Leading Investor Accelerator For Venture Capital, Private Equity, & Angel Investing
company.description:
Venture University is the world's leading investor accelerator for individuals breaking into venture capital, private equity, and angel investing. 

VU has two investor accelerators: 1) The Venture Capital Investor Accelerator, 2) The Real Estate Private Equity & REIT Investor Accelerator.  Both programs are triple certificate programs. Each Investor Acceelrator includes an Education Program (Masterclass, Advanced Modules, Deal Madness, Fireside Chats) and an Investment Apprenticeship Program where individuals build a gain high quality investment experience, build a track record by making VC/PE investments, and receive a profit sharing agreement to share in the financial upside.  

Individuals "learn by doing" by joining VU Venture Partners, a multi-stage global venture capital fund, investing in ~2-4 new portfolio companies per quarter, across Consumer, Enterprise, Fintech, Frontier Tech, Healthcare, and Proptech, and VU Capital Partners, a real estate private equity and growth equity fund.

During the program individuals receive mentorship, career development, VC/PE industry networking, and learn from and work alongside top performing investment professionals who have invested $9B+ and have over 100+ yrs of investment experience across venture capital and real estate private equity. 

Venture University accepts <2% of the applications it receives, making it more competitive to get into than the top Ivy League schools and MBA programs.

VU's mission is to curate and develop the top diverse talent for the VC/PE industry and to generate consistent and superior financial returns for investors.
